identifiability.classifier_caveat: pooled AUC measures whether twin families can be told apart from each other; leave-one-family-out AUC measures whether a 'language vs non-language' boundary transfers to an unseen mechanism. If the latter is <= 0.5 the Voynich probability is not interpretable and is not used in the verdict.
identifiability.verdict: NO TWIN: none of the five families reaches Voynich's own block-to-block variation on the fit features (best naibbe/it 2.11 vs floor median 0.99, p90 1.29). Identifiability between meaningful and meaningless mechanisms therefore cannot be established or refuted at the level of an exact twin. Held-out comparisons are mixed (see pairwise table); no robust separation.
